completion_receipt_protocol.circularity_rule: Hash domains are disjoint: receipt_preimage_v1 excludes all SUPERVISOR_CLOSED event-derived values. SUPERVISOR_CLOSED binds only receipt_preimage_sha256. The final receipt, produced after close, adds actual closeout_head outside the preimage hash domain.
commit: append the exact already-derived SUPERVISOR_CLOSED envelope
reopen and verify actual event equals derived event byte-for-byte and hash-for-hash
precompute: freeze all preimage fields after lease release record
construct SUPERVISOR_CLOSED payload from transaction_id receipt_preimage_sha256 and frozen result references only
construct exact event envelope from expected sequence expected_prev_event_sha256 event_id event_type payload and canonical event schema
compute close_event_payload_sha256 and close_event_sha256; neither feeds back into receipt_preimage_v1
persist and fdatasync preimage plus derived-close-event fixture before append
publish_after_close: construct COMPLETION-RECEIPT.json with receipt_preimage_v1 fields receipt_preimage_sha256 and actual closeout_head
actual closeout_head contains close sequence close event sha256 and payload sha256
reopen rehash and verify preimage projection and actual close event
release transaction lock only after verification
completion_receipt_protocol.recovery: If close event exists, reconstruct final receipt from stored verified preimage and actual close event. If absent, verify stored derived event and append exactly once. No fixed-point iteration, no journal append after close.

closeout_head.meaning: final canonical journal event; no append follows

semantic_reduction_head.meaning: frozen semantic prefix ending at fence

mandatory_fence.terminal_seal_rule: TERMINAL-SEAL.json is CAS-published after TERMINAL_DECISION; TERMINAL_SEAL_RECORDED is the canonical nonsemantic closeout event binding its hash.
